briefs.name: courtyard
briefs.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: high-resolution landscape architecture photograph for Cyrus Scatter website hero and environment gallery. Generate ONE photorealistic image, landscape 4:3 composition, ideally 3840 x 2880 pixels, the highest native resolution available. A beautifully designed quiet contemporary courtyard: broad pale limestone steps lead from the foreground toward an elegant low pavilion with warm limestone walls and tall dark glass windows in the right background. Mature sculptural multi-stem trees, dense layers of fine grasses, silver-green foliage, delicate white perennial flowers, restrained lavender, varied shrubs frame the steps. Show sophisticated deliberate planting, airy varied forms and convincing leaf detail. Balanced composition, path centrally located, architecture on the right, planting visible across frame. Foreground stone texture and flower heads exceptionally crisp; realistic individual leaves, finely detailed bark, subtle worn limestone, no repeated cloned trees. Soft warm morning sunlight, natural highlights, no fog, no overexposure, no mist or artificial blur. High-end editorial landscape photography, 35mm lens, f/8 deep focus, natural sage/olive and warm ivory palette. No people, no writing, no logos, no border, no website interface, no typography, no collage. Do not bake in gradient or text space; website supplies its own gradient. All parts of the image should retain photographic detail and clean edges.
